text:
sam-sre: alert from secret-scan — found an API token in a test-data blob on s3 (s3://redwood-dev/testdata/2026-03-20/samples.json). appears to be a short-lived service token starting with 'rwd_'. i pulled the sample and redacted it here.

security-bot: [automated] secret-scan v2.3 detected potential credential in object s3://redwood-dev/testdata/2026-03-20/samples.json (scan-id=ss-20260320-17). severity: medium. rule: service-token-pattern.

kevin-sec: @sam-sre thanks. can you paste the exact matched line (redacted) and any commit/branch info? need to kick off rotation.

sam-sre: matched line: \"api_key\": \"rwd_XXXXxxXXxxXX_redacted\" in the blob. file was uploaded from dev branch `feature/file-upload` by maria-dev. commit: 8f3b2a7. example grep i ran:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-dev/testdata/2026-03-20/samples.json - | jq '.items[] | select(.api_key != null)'
# returned the object above
```

maria-dev: yep that was me — used local sandbox creds while generating test fixtures. i thought they were ephemeral. sorry. i will stop all related runs.

kevin-sec: immediate steps: 1) revoke token; 2) query auth logs for any use; 3) check if token tied to customer data; 4) rotate and re-issue scoped token if needed. @maria-dev please share the token ID if you still have it (or the full redacted match). do not paste full token in channel.

maria-dev: i still have the shell where i generated it. token id: abc123 (last 6 chars). i did not push the secret to git, only to s3 test blob. runs happened from my laptop and a CI debug job (build-1024).

dmitri-ci: CI job build-1024 had the test artifact uploaded to s3. i can pull the artifact logs. build-1024 logs: `uploader@ci: uploaded samples.json` — no downstream steps used the token. 

kevin-sec: i'm revoking token id=abc123 now.

kevin-sec: `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.example/keys/abc123/revoke -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SEC_ADMIN\"`

security-bot: [automated] key abc123 revoked by kevin-sec at 2026-03-20T18:12:45Z

kevin-sec: searching logs for auth usage of abc123 (elk):
```
# timeframe 2026-03-20T00:00..2026-03-20T18:12
query: event_type:auth AND token_id:abc123
# no auth success events found. 2 failed attempts from maria-dev's IP (VPN) and 1 test request from CI runner (no downstream effect)
```

jen-support: any customer impact? we should prepare a short blurb if we need to notify customers.

alice-psr: ive checked data access mapping for that token: it was created with service-role `test-uploads` and only had read/write to a staging bucket (no production customer buckets). looks like no customer PII was in that blob. low customer impact.

kevin-sec: good. still we'll add an audit log entry and run a scoped investigation for 72h. actions so far: revoked token, confirmed no successful auth outside dev IPs, CI usage benign. next: rotate any linked service account credentials and update CI artifacts.

maria-dev: I'm going to re-run test data generation with new ephemeral tokens and update the fixture pipeline to strip secrets before upload.

dmitri-ci: i'll add a pipeline step to delete secrets from artifacts and enable artifact scanning for future builds. plan to add `trufflehog` scan and fail on high-confidence matches.

kevin-sec: also need a pre-commit/pre-push hook in dev repo and a GitHub action to fail PRs if `rwd_` pattern is found. dmitri — can you open a PR for the CI changes? tag me.

dmitri-ci: will do. PR target: add artifact-scan job + `rm -f` sanitizer for known keys.

maria-dev: sorry again. i'll do a short writeup for my team and add a checklist: never upload credentials, use vault-backed tokens, scrub test artifacts.

kevin-sec: final items before we close: 1) postmortem draft (alice-psr + sam-sre) 2) update onboarding docs to mention artifact scanning (jen-support) 3) add KMS-backed generation for ephemeral test tokens (security + dev infra). assign owners and ETA 3 days.

alice-psr: i'll start the postmortem doc and link to the evidence (s3 object, scan output, CI logs).

jen-support: i'll prepare a short internal note for support and a customer-facing template (if needed) but we won't send it unless status changes.

sam-sre: current status: token revoked, no customer impact, CI patched pending PR, postmortem in progress. marking this thread resolved for now. please ping if you find anything new.

kevin-sec: thumbs up. follow-up item: implement KMS integration for dev token issuance by EOD next week. tagging: @alice-psr @dmitri-ci @maria-dev for owner alignment.

maria-dev: confirmed. i'll be the owner for the dev-side changes.

security-bot: [automated] thread closed by kevin-sec at 2026-03-20T19:05:00Z — follow-ups tracked in internal ticket SEC-2026-432.
